BC_description: When the encoding option is set to 'buffer', the output properties (result.stdout, result.stderr, result.all) now return a Uint8Array instead of a Buffer, which may break code expecting Buffer methods or properties. Additionally, support for encoding: null has been removed, and it is no longer a valid option.
Adaptation_method: Replace Buffer-specific methods with Uint8Array equivalents. For example, if using Buffer.toString(), use new TextDecoder().decode(stdout). Example: const { stdout } = await execa('node', ['file.js'], { encoding: 'buffer' }); console.log(new TextDecoder().decode(stdout)); // Decodes Uint8Array to string. Also, remove any usage of encoding: null as it is no longer supported.
